title: [3.1.0.2] Loop suddenly stops invoking
symptom: Loop is not activated on new BG readings. The app sometimes misses new readings, as seen on overview screen (prediction lines extending from previous reading) and loop screen (last run more than 5 min ago). Occurs daily, no logs generated at time of issue.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. One user reports the problem stopped after updating to Android 13, suggesting OS interference, but this is not confirmed by maintainers.
fix: The thread suggests updating to the latest dev version (which reportedly resolved the issue for one user) and updating to Android 13 (which stopped the problem for another user). However, no specific configuration change is stated.
evidence_quote: The problem stopped reoccurring when updated to android 13 (One UI 5) some 3 weeks ago!!!!!!! Probably my OS was interfering...
